                    ### Question

opd. He was involved in a bar fight and experienced a ruptured globe 10 years ago

This chronic sun exposure increases his risk of developing a pterygium, which aligns with the presentation of the 'thing' on his eye. The evidence path confirming the link between chronic sun exposure and pterygium supports this reasoning.
